alias: Cameras - engine log archive card dismissed (acknowledges)
description: Dismissing the engine-log archive card acknowledges the events it showed: presses input_button.camera_log_archive_acknowledge, so binary_sensor.camera_log_archive_events turns off. Only while that sensor is on: camera_log_archive_event_cleared dismisses the card itself once it is off, and that dismissal must not press again. Only when the card was drawn at or after the newest event (created_at, reset by every rewrite, not older than last_event_at): an event that arrived after the card was last drawn was never on screen, so it stays raised and the next re-assert redraws the card. 'Dismiss all' counts as a dismissal. A restart removes no card (they are not kept across it), so a reboot never acknowledges.
